mechanism_narrative: A higher absolute level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) signals a 'sticky inflation' regime, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.5% is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units signals weak demand conditions, which are associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1700, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher absolute level of residential sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals a supply shock, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
